name: Support triage
description: Routing and answer checks for the bundled demo pipeline (retrieval-augmented support assistant). Each case checks the intent classifier's label; some also check that the formatted answer addresses the topic, and three are graded by the LLM judge, which is skipped in simulated mode.

cases.input: Why was I charged twice this month?
How can I get a refund for my annual plan?

checks.criteria: Tells the customer how to request a refund for an annual plan, or where to find the refund policy, without inventing amounts, dates, or guarantees.

cases.input: Can I change the credit card on my account?
Where can I download last month's invoice?
The app crashes every time I upload a file.

checks.criteria: Offers concrete troubleshooting steps for a crash during file upload (for example checking the file size or format, updating the app, or contacting support) and does not blame the customer.

cases.input: I get a 500 error when I try to log in.
Sync between my phone and my laptop stopped working.
Can I talk to a human agent?

checks.criteria: Explains how the customer can reach a human support agent, in a polite and helpful tone.
